ResourceBasicInfo.Name: Tamil Literature Corpus
ResourceBasicInfo.Title: Tamil Literature Corpus
ResourceBasicInfo.Description: This dataset is a comprehensive Tamil text corpus compiled from diverse sources to capture the richness and variability of the Tamil language. It includes a wide range of text types such as news articles, literature, online content, and conversational data, making it suitable for multiple natural language processing (NLP) tasks. The corpus has been cleaned and preprocessed to remove noise while preserving linguistic nuances, ensuring high-quality input for model training and evaluation. It can be used for applications such as language modeling, machine translation, sentiment analysis, and text classification. Additionally, the dataset aims to support research and development for low-resource language technologies and promote inclusivity in AI systems by strengthening resources for Tamil.
